readyDescription: Pick the languages, then drag the floating panel anywhere you like
settings.title: Settings

baidu.errorMissingAppId: Enter your Baidu App ID before starting translation.
baidu.errorMissingKey: Enter your Baidu secret key before starting translation.

baidu.errorInvalidResponse: The Baidu service returned an unreadable response. Please try again.

provider.googleHint: Uses Google Translate. No API key is required.
provider.mymemoryHint: Free public service with a daily quota. No API key is required.
provider.baiduHint: Baidu Translate API. Free monthly quota after identity verification; requires an App ID and secret key.
provider.externalApiHint: Uses your OpenAI-compatible API and its billing plan.
provider.indexTranslateHint: Bilibili's free public API. No API key required. 35B-A3B is the most accurate; 9B and 2B are faster.
indexTranslate.freeNote: Free public API — no API key. Translated text is sent to Bilibili's servers.
indexTranslate.errorRequestFailed: The Index-Translate request failed. Please try again.
indexTranslate.errorNetworkFailed: Could not reach the Index-Translate service. Check your network or proxy settings and try again.
finalTranslation.title: Final translation
finalTranslation.hint: Provisional captions use the service above. When enabled, the settled translation is produced by the service below.
finalTranslation.mainProviderHint: The service above is used for provisional captions only.
externalApi.errorMissingBaseUrl: Enter an external API base URL before starting translation.
externalApi.errorInvalidBaseUrl: Enter a valid external API base URL.
externalApi.errorInsecureUrl: External API URLs must use HTTPS unless they point to localhost.
externalApi.errorMissingKey: Enter an API key before starting translation.
externalApi.errorMissingModel: Enter a model name before starting translation.
externalApi.errorMissingTranslation: The external API response did not include translated text.
externalApi.errorPermissionDenied: Allow access to the external API before starting translation.
externalApi.errorRequestFailed: The external API request failed. Check your URL, model, and API key.
model.autoHint: Picks the model based on your device's power.
model.balancedHint: More accurate, a bit slower. ~290 MB download the first time.
model.dolphinHint: Tuned for Japanese (and 40 other Asian languages). Most accurate option. ~250 MB download the first time.
downloadingModelDetail: First time only — it's saved for next time
playToStart: Play the video to see the translation here
waitingForSpeechHint: Make sure the video is playing and this tab has audio.
dolphin.errorDownloadFailed: Could not download the Dolphin model. Check your connection and try again.
dolphin.errorLoadFailed: Could not start the Dolphin model on this device. Try a different model in Settings.
dolphin.errorTranscribeFailed: The Dolphin model failed while transcribing. Try again.
captureEnded: Translation stopped — the source tab was closed
captureNotAllowed: This tab can't be captured. Open the panel from the AuraLang icon on the tab you want to translate (Chrome's internal pages can't be translated).
captureNotStarted: Audio capture did not start. Reload the page and start again.
floatingWindowHint: Tip: click the button at the top-right of the video to keep the captions in an always-on-top window.
